Integrate operational status and document the complete supported user workflow.

## Scope

- App integration
- Launcher/lifecycle

## Entry conditions

- Feature owners and qualification routes are integrated.

## Exit criteria

- The app and CLI share accurate operational outcomes.
- Source guidance and all build-bound reader inputs are ready for release packaging.

- Late changes to bound reader input require rebuilding, not manual bundle edits.

### Risks

- Avoid exposing internal-only data or native/private Task material in public reader views.

## TASK-026 - Integrate verified launcher and session lifecycle

Make the supported launcher use the recorded compatible runtime and preserve secure on-demand launch, revocation and shutdown.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-025, REQ-035 |

| Dependencies | TASK-025 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A successful CLI reader or executable mode check alone is not browser/lifecycle evidence.

### Acceptance criteria

- The correct child identity and reviewed assets open through the actual launcher without a startup install/build.
- Loopback/source/Host/Origin/session/CSRF controls remain intact; stopping qualification-owned services leaves unrelated sessions unchanged.

### Planned verification

- Run affected service/session refusal, revocation and package-change checks.
- In Phase 9 launch through the real entry, close the reading session, stop the owned service and inspect cleanup.

### Risks

- Finish build-bound documentation changes before Phase 8; a later such change requires re-packaging and affected requalification.

### Acceptance criteria

- Current instructions state full operational defaults, three setup routes, supported hosts, explicit choices and safe resume/assessment with no stale current-edition descriptions.
- Handoff output reports selected coverage, exact runtime/content/evidence scope and blockers; historical editions and immutable records retain their original meaning.

### Planned verification

- Check examples against the final CLI/owner interfaces and resolve all changed local links.
- Review terminology across guide, helper outcomes and reader Health; verify no new automatic external action or root Task policy propagation.
